title: The AI graveyard: a running list of projects and startups that didn’t make it
summary: From Apple's repeatedly delayed Siri AI to OpenAI's messy "super app" launch, here's a look at the AI projects that shut down or missed expectations.
llm_summary: The piece chronicles a growing “AI graveyard,” highlighting high‑profile initiatives that fizzled— from Apple’s repeatedly postponed Siri enhancements to OpenAI’s chaotic attempt at a “super app.” It shows how even well‑funded, headline‑grabbing projects can stall or shut down when technical hurdles, market timing, or execution fall short.
